BETA Close X RS Group PLC has announced the purchase of 3,644,222 ordinary shares as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases, conducted between July 27 and July 31, 2026, at prices ranging from 683.0000 pence to 711.0000 pence per share, will be cancelled. Following these transactions, the company will have 470,405,246 ordinary shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 470,405,246 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 03 August 2026 RS Group plc 3 August 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 27 July 2026 to 31 July 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 470,405,246 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 470,405,246. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
